# tspub

> The unified TypeScript package toolkit — init, build, check, publish in one tool.

tspub replaces publint + @arethetypeswrong/cli + @changesets/cli + tsup with a single dependency.

## Commands

- `tspub init [name]` — Scaffold a new TypeScript package
- `tspub build` — Build ESM + CJS + .d.ts (uses tsdown)
- `tspub check` — Validate package against 60 rules
- `tspub check --fix` — Auto-fix issues
- `tspub check --format json` — JSON output for CI
- `tspub check --format table` — Type resolution table
- `tspub check --list-rules` — List all rules
- `tspub check --ignore-rules <ids>` — Skip rules
- `tspub check --profile strict|library|app` — Presets
- `tspub publish [bump]` — Build + check + version + publish
- `tspub doctor` — Diagnose issues
- `tspub doctor --fix` — Auto-repair
- `tspub scan <url>` — Scan GitHub repo
- `tspub changeset` — Create changeset
- `tspub changeset version` — Bump versions
- `tspub changeset status` — Show pending
- `tspub changeset snapshot` — Snapshot release
- `tspub test-types` — Run .test-d.ts tests
- `tspub pack` — Preview published files

## Configuration

File: `tspub.config.ts`

```typescript
import type { TspubConfig } from "tspub";
export default { build: {}, check: {}, publish: {}, changeset: {} } satisfies TspubConfig;
```

## Rule Categories

- exports (23 rules) — Export field validation
- types (9 rules) — TypeScript config & resolution
- files (7 rules) — File inclusion & format
- metadata (8 rules) — Package metadata
- size (1 rule) — Package size

## Key Rules

- exports/type-module — type: "module" is set
- exports/exports-field — exports field exists
- exports/types-order — types condition comes first
- exports/default-last — default is last condition
- types/resolution — Types resolve in node10/node16/bundler
- files/sensitive — No .env or credentials published
- files/bin-shebang — Bin files have shebang

## Programmatic API

```typescript
import { check, build, scan, doctor, scaffold, runTypeTests } from "tspub";
import { discoverWorkspaces, topoSort, loadConfig } from "tspub";
import type { Rule, TspubConfig, CheckResult } from "tspub";
```
